venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 9/4.** Missed target: net $6,143 vs $6,582 target (−7%); food $589; 215 guests, $28.58 check avg; comps $85.45. MOD JK/Mkz. Friday before Labor Day — push of folks 5–6pm, sold a few meal deals and Summer Friday cocktails; keep informing guests of upcoming activations like Thursday Night Football as Summer Fridays wind down. DJ (OS) opened at 9pm and kept a great vibe — different DJ styles are benefiting the room. Slower Friday than normal; good chance to put Joe's notes to use — lean into the back bar and create connections. Even with slower pace, lots of regulars — community is growing. Kitchen: good day, use BOH time well. 86 plastic cups. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: seeing lots of regulars. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 9/4.** Beat target: net $11,592 vs $10,774 target (+8%); food $394; 428 guests, $26.94 check avg; comps $175. MOD KE / Chef JMS. Good service overall — strong 4–9pm, hour-or-two drop-off, then a steady push until 1am. Arlene Park in with a dozen friends celebrating their first group reunion since before COVID; Thomas from Oku brought his newest bar-team hire; Nikki and friend (Neuhoff regulars) back after a long while. Kitchen: smooth sailing. 86: Lassi Mix, Super Martini (low Super Brine), TK Mule, Pet Nat Paloma; low grenadine. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: the party hit it off with Joe. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 9/4.** Beat target: net $20,504 vs $17,360 target (+18%); no events (event fields n/a). AM $2,018 / D&C PM $13,192 / Garden-6A $5,294; food $3,916; 327 guests (Tock), ~$62.70 check avg; comps $671 (incl. $200 member-table 10% discount, $120 gift, $97 DNL). AM MOD Evan + Josh; PM Maggie S & Walcott. AM: awesome day with Care, busy throughout; cold brew set for tomorrow; good chunk of IRDs and a nice cocktail pop into 3. PM: a slow-ish Friday as expected — 3-day weekends send people to the mountains. Stayed full but no waitlist beyond a short one at 6pm; no rail needed, cut openers by 11pm. Big member party for Matthew stayed 6 hours celebrating family weddings; 12-top of bachelorettes, 8-top of friends, lots of big parties but no big pops. Kitchen cranked big tickets all night. Garden: Frosty Factory didn't chill the fro'spro — hoping it's the heat, not mechanical; may need service if it fails tomorrow. Break make-up not complete; no-shows not charged; no incidents. Favorite moment: big hugs from member Matt & wife Kelly. Entered by MS.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 9/4.** Beat target: net $8,119 vs $8,047 target (+1%); food $452, beverage $7,667; 234 guests (SevenRooms), $35 check avg; comps $167.50. MOD Kyler & Steves. Lowkey but high-GCA first three hours (dates coursing an entrée with a round), ramped up and went insane 10pm–midnight, medium flow till 1:30. Elevated by an 8-top going deep on esoteric orders. Back-catalog banger: Javelle rich stone-fruit julep. 234 covers, 6 large parties, 3 solos, 0 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Paper Wasp, Shinebox, Rosalie. Door: slow open with lots of two-tops leaving quick by 7pm; full by 8:30 with a medium waitlist (~1 hr duos, 1.5 hr larger groups), at capacity until 12:45am. Andy (local regular) with 7; Mark Gorham with 8 cocktail enthusiasts; 2 anniversaries, 2 birthdays; Evan in for a nightcap. No-shows: 2 parties, not charged. Menu count 18; breakage 1 SOF, 1 DOF. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 9/4.** Beat target: net $13,106 vs $11,693 target (+12%); food $1,609; Standing Room $4,989 incl. $4,000 event (birthday buyout); 238 guests, $84.32 check avg; comps $382 (investors, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL, service recovery). MOD Gigi + Joe + Josh + Saleh. Steady Friday: 138 covers on the books, 40 of them a birthday buyout in Standing Room 9pm–midnight. Opened SR early for walk-ins before the party; bulk of resos 8–10pm built a big waitlist that the team burned and turned through; most resos in by 11pm when the waitlist cleared. Room filled once more for last call — smooth ending. SR party (Michael) had an amazing time. Kitchen: nice work. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: SR party bringing the vibes. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 9/4.** Missed target: net $6,590.27 vs $9,235 target (−29%). Marquee $6,297.42, Garden $461, food $842; 191 guests, $29.16 GCA ($73.25 check avg); comps $168.15, voids $170. MOD Marcus / Josh. Garden: extremely slow — real-feel 103°, thunder and lightning early; Labor Day exodus felt. Walk-ins from ~8:45pm, some moved into the Marquee; internet outage stopped Garden tickets printing to the kitchen so a few food items were comped; cuts made and Garden closed by 11:30pm. Marquee: slow start on resos and walk-ins, built to ~90% seated, then a hard lull from midnight through last call; internet flapping caused a couple of double rings voided. Team stayed engaged and pushed food and back-bar picks. Not the Friday hoped for but handled well. Kitchen: light night, mostly snacks; James held it down. Kitchen close checked. Went well: flow of service, labor adjustments; better: resetting to zero. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Maintenance: ice machine slow leak, curtains. Favorite moment: couple from Iowa in for HYROX. Entered by Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 9/4.** Net $11,279 (Municipal Bar AM $0 / PM $8,983, Sun Club $362, Hot Eye $1,898); target entered as 0 (not set); food entered as $0 and evening OpenTable count entered as 0 (morning 34) — food and guest count treated as not reported, no check avg computed; comps $444. AM MOD Braden / Sam & Lex; PM Sam & Marcus. AM: slow start with hotel breakfast guests; large planter broken and out of linens but survived; picked up mid-day with a push at 1:30 and Ezra hopping in. PM: happy hour nearly empty 3–4, mostly full by 5pm; well staffed and firing; light food and drinking early, not many large parties; 7–8pm biggest hour, steady after, cuts from 8pm; barback and server assistant were a big help. Hot Eye: painfully slow start, picked up by 9:30, busy room by 10 with lots of big parties at the end — lots of SCAD and out-of-town groups, no industry; back-bar cleaning done in the lull. No incidents. Favorite moment: connecting with guests during the downtime. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Friday 9/4.** Beat target: net $10,922 vs $10,000 target (+9%); food $1,147; 259 guests, $42.17 check avg; comps $911.08 (one walkout $151.20; manager comps SND & DNL $248; shifties $103; a manager meal and many investors; voids $201). MOD Julian Abel. Service very smooth and much more organized — everyone broke before the bar blew up; still ironing out Toast details and SOPs, but the team worked for each other and closed faster with a better vibe. Kitchen: slower on food; 86 oyster crackers; Wes killed it and got Josh out. Low/86: Elijah Craig. Maintenance: cleaner for the Rational oven. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: inventing the Tomato Back (Linie & Tomolive juice). Entered by Julian Abel.
